name: Craxa WOODASH Connector
author: Craxa Technologies

sections.description:
WOODASH Connector allows you to securely generate the necessary REST API keys (Consumer Key and Consumer Secret) for your WooCommerce store with just one click. You can connect your store to the WOODASH Desktop Application without dealing with complex WooCommerce settings.

By downloading the WOODASH application, you can:
* Receive instant desktop voice notifications for new orders,
* Manage orders, customers, products, and coupons from a single interface,
* Track advanced store statistics.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin file.
  2. Go to your WordPress Admin Panel > Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click the Upload Plugin button, select the zip file, and upload it.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Click on the WOODASH tab in the left menu.
  6. Click the “Generate WOODASH API Key” button and paste the generated details into your WOODASH Desktop application.
